# Offline effect volumes

`crates/og-cook/src/cook/systems/effect_texture/volume.rs` adapts the semi-Lagrangian advection and pressure-projection steps of [AndrewBlackwell/fluid-sim](https://github.com/AndrewBlackwell/fluid-sim), revision `5a24bf80cb33aa3667e60c71265f3f10b0a3d89b` (2026, MIT, license alongside), from a 2D interactive solver to a deterministic 3D offline volume. Differences: trilinear interpolation, six-neighbour Jacobi pressure solve, open zero-inflow boundaries, explicit scalar density/heat transport, authored buoyancy, seeded shared curl forcing, Fedkiw vorticity confinement, directional transmittance sweeps for self-shadowing, and straight-alpha Beer-Lambert integration. No OpenGL, OpenMP, UI or upstream dependency is included.

The method follows Stam, *Stable Fluids* (SIGGRAPH 1999), Fedkiw, Stam and Jensen, *Visual Simulation of Smoke* (SIGGRAPH 2001), and Bridson et al., *Curl-Noise for Procedural Fluid Flow* (SIGGRAPH 2007). The 2025 MIT implementation [Stable-Fluids-Reloaded](https://github.com/flow-zone/Stable-Fluids-Reloaded) was also surveyed: its FFT periodic boundaries and PyTorch dependency are inappropriate for isolated transparent cook assets, so neither code nor dependencies are included. This is an explicit coarse-grid inviscid approximation, not a combustion or compressible shock-wave solver.
